entities.name: Query HtpX protease
observations: 349 aa bacterial membrane protein with exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A9IZD8.
Predicted/annotated as a multi-pass inner-membrane zinc metalloprotease of the HtpX family.
Contains Pfam Peptidase_M48 domain PF01435.25 at residues 71–278.

entities.name: HtpX protease A9IZD8
observations: Reviewed Bartonella tribocorum HtpX homolog; exact sequence hash match to the query.
Annotated as cell inner membrane, multi-pass membrane protein.
GO annotations: metalloendopeptidase activity, zinc ion binding, and proteolysis.

entities.name: Bacterial membrane proteolysis
observations: The protein is associated with proteolysis at the bacterial plasma/inner membrane, based on GO:0006508 and membrane-localization annotations.

entities.name: Query HtpX sequence properties
observations: Length 349 aa; molecular weight approximately 37.64 kDa; theoretical pI 6.77; predicted charge at pH 7 approximately −0.68.
